name: Smooth Level Enter
description: Smoooooothly transition into playing a level!

override-length.name: Override Length
override-length.description: Overrides the length of the transition to force it to be 1 second, regardless of any other mod or ingame setting.

animate-out-level-page.name: Animate Level Page
animate-out-level-page.description: Whether to animate out the level page.

legacy-easing.name: Legacy Easing
legacy-easing.description: Use the legacy Bounce Out easing for blocks in the level, over the newer Exponential Out easing.
